title: Replay of the retained word
statement: Let $x,a$ be Boolean words and let $i\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $i\le |x|$. For every natural number $j\le |a|$, after $j$ steps from state $3$ with $a$ stored on the work tape, the work-tape head at position $0$, and empty output, the machine remains in state $3$, has its work-tape head at position $j$, and has emitted the first $j$ bits of $a$; the input-head position and stored word are unchanged.
replaced:
From the stripping machine's replay state with buffer $a$ and work head at
displacement $0$, for any $j \le \abs{a}$, exactly $j$ steps move the work
head to displacement $j$ and emit the first $j$ bits of $a$, preserving the
buffer.
